full_track.tags: K-Indie folk ballad. A clean, warm acoustic guitar plays a steady fingerstyle pattern with alternating bass notes and arpeggiated chords. A soft, melodic male vocal sits forward in the mix with light plate reverb. A subtle upright bass enters with long, sustained notes on the root. The arrangement is sparse and intimate. Key of G Major. Tempo is 72 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
